focus_areas: 3D spatial grounding and separation of the gondola from the envelope
Tail fin structure, connectivity, and 3D depth
Text rendering quality (overlay and side logo)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the depth relationship between the gondola and the hull: does the depth map show a clear gap, or do they occupy the same depth plane (indicating melting)? Verify if the tail fins have valid mechanical attachment points or if they appear to melt into the hull. Also, analyze the text artifacts: is the gibberish at the bottom indicative of a generative model failure, and does the side logo maintain consistent perspective with the curved surface?
image_description: A white airship (dirigible) with red lettering on its side floats in a blue sky above a layer of clouds. The craft features an elongated, cigar-shaped envelope, a gondola suspended beneath the forward section, and tail fins. There is illegible text overlay at the bottom right corner.
